name: ids
description: Generate identifiers (AssemblyScript): UUID v4, ULID (sortable by creation time), or a short random hex id. WHEN TO USE: a card, run, or correlation id is needed and nothing in the task already implies one. Input: {"kind": "uuid4"|"ulid"|"short", "count": 1, "length": 8}. kind defaults to uuid4, count defaults to 1 (max 100 per call), length (short only) defaults to 8 hex characters (max 64).
llm_description: Generate identifiers. {"kind":"uuid4"|"ulid"|"short","count":1,"length":8}. kind defaults uuid4; count defaults 1 (max 100); length (short only) defaults 8 hex chars (max 64).

kind.description: uuid4, ulid, or short. Defaults to uuid4.

count.description: How many ids to generate, newline-separated. Defaults to 1, max 100.

length.description: Hex characters for kind "short". Defaults to 8, max 64.
